title: U14 Girls Crowned League Champions
excerpt: A dominant second-half display saw our U14 girls lift the Division 2 league title after an unbeaten campaign.
body:
A dominant second-half display saw our U14 girls lift the Division 2 league title after an unbeaten campaign.

Level at half time against a strong Carbury side, the girls hit 2-6 without reply in a superb third quarter and never looked back.

Well done to the players, management and parents on a brilliant season — and it's not over yet, with championship starting next month.
